item.title: Garden -Kyouki no Hakoniwa-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: LI Project
  • 発売日: 2011-06-04
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Garden -狂気の箱庭-
  • 英語名: Garden -Kyouki no Hakoniwa-

别名

  • Garden of Madness

あらすじ

The young boy collapsed in the woods.

His memories were lost.

It seemed he was now the live-in servant of a grand estate.

To get his memories back he continued this work… but

strange things are afoot in this home…

Mystery x crossdressing R-18 original novel!

Fully voiced characters with ON/OFF!
